content: The text lists contributors to the fourth edition of the Guidelines for Drinking-Water Quality, which incorporates the first and second addenda. These individuals represent a wide range of expertise and institutions from across the globe, including universities, government agencies, international organizations, and independent consultants. Their affiliations span countries such as Germany, the United States, Australia, Japan, the United Kingdom, Canada, and many others. The contributors include professionals from fields such as public health, environmental science, water management, and engineering, reflecting the multidisciplinary nature of the work. Their collective efforts have contributed to the development and refinement of guidelines aimed at ensuring safe and high-quality drinking water worldwide.
